description.value:
This thing looks like it was cobbled together by some gonk-brained DIYer, but it shoots like a dream. Gives you the additional hope of seeing yet another Night City sunrise.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear, Power Rebuild, TUp (Can be Concealed) Stun Bayonet • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon may load Non-Basic Ammunition. All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear]. If this weapon’s user has moved at least 8m/yds on foot during a Round of combat, until the start of their next Turn when they roll for damage with this weapon, they may roll an additional damage d6 and drop the lowest die (4d6 Drop Lowest in Single Shot, 3d6 Drop Lowest in Autofire).

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear, Power Rebuild, TUp (Can be Concealed) Stun Bayonet (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
